product_metadata.title: Madison Park Aubrey 100% Cotton Luxurious Bath Towel Set Highly Absorbent, Quick Dry, Jacquard Paisley Design, Hotel & Spa Quality for Bathroom Decor, Multi-Sizes, Black 6 Piece
features: 100% cotton terry absorbant pieced paisley jacquard end hem set includes: 2 bath towels, 2 hand towels and 2 fingertip towels
2 Bath Towels:27"W x 52"L (2) 2 Hand Towels:16"W x 28"L (2) 2 Fingertip Towels:12"W x 18"L (2)
description: Add a sophisticated style to your bathroom with our Madison Park Aubrey 6 Piece Jacquard Towel Set. This towel set features a pieced design with a woven paisley jacquard hem, in rich black and gold hues, for an elegant and decorative touch. These cotton towels are also OEKO-TEX certified, meaning they do not contain any harmful substances, ensuring quality comfort and wellness. Made from 100% cotton terry, this towel set is incredibly soft, absorbent, and machine washable for easy care. Place these jacquard cotton towels in your bathroom to add the perfect finishing touches to your traditional style decor. Coordinating shower curtains and rugs are available and sold separately for a complete look. Set includes: 2 standard 27x52" bath towels, 2 standard 16x28" hand towels, and 2 standard 12x18" fingertip towels.

details.Product Care Instructions: Wash before first use. Machine wash gentle cycle with like color in cold water. Only use non-chlorine bleach when needed. Do not wash with sharp items that may pull the towel fibers, such as zippers or hooks. To maintain the quality and performance of your towels, avoid the use of fabric softeners and dry sheets. Tumble dry low, remove promptly. Cool iron if necessary. Fold towels neatly and store in a dry ventilated place. Before use, simply shake towels to restore fluff and pile.
